dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Newly diagnosed, previously untreated diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS (SNOMED 109969005; ICD-10-CM C83.30), non-germinal-center (activated B-cell-like) subtype

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: Non-germinal-center B-cell-like (ABC-like) phenotype by the Hans algorithm (CD10 negative, BCL6 positive, MUM1/IRF4 positive in approximately 70% of cells)

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor / Lugano stage IIIBS with bulky disease - i.e. stage III, B symptoms, splenic involvement, no extranodal (E) disease.

stage_spleen_nodal.quote: because the spleen is a lymphoid organ this does NOT upstage to IV, and this distinction is worth stating explicitly at tumor board

stage_bulky_b_symptoms.quote: Bulky disease by Lugano / International Working Group criteria: largest nodal mass 11.0 cm (>=10 cm).

mn_stage_iv.quote: because the spleen is a lymphoid organ this does NOT upstage to IV

mn_spleen_extranodal_count.quote: IPI 3 of 5: age 62 (>60) = 1, elevated LDH = 1, stage III = 1, ECOG 1 (i.e. <2) = 0, no extranodal sites = 0.

mol_de_not_dh.quote: Double-expressor by IHC: MYC positive in approximately 50% of tumor cells (threshold >=40%) and BCL2 positive in approximately 80% (threshold >=50%)

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: shows NO rearrangement of MYC (8q24), BCL2 (18q21) or BCL6 (3q27), so this is not HGBL-DH or HGBL-TH

mn_denies_double_expressor.quote: Double-expressor by IHC: MYC positive in approximately 50% of tumor cells (threshold >=40%) and BCL2 positive in approximately 80% (threshold >=50%)

prog_ipi_3.quote: IPI 3 of 5: age 62 (>60) = 1, elevated LDH = 1, stage III = 1, ECOG 1 (i.e. <2) = 0, no extranodal sites = 0.

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.quote: High risk by the CNS-IPI, score 4 of 8: age over 60 (1), elevated LDH (1), ECOG performance status >=1 (1), stage III/IV (1)

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Polatuzumab vedotin plus R-CHP (pola-R-CHP), 6 cycles of 21 days, followed by involved-site radiotherapy (ISRT) to the bulky retroperitoneal mass.

tx_pola_preferred.quote: disease is non-GCB/ABC-like, which is precisely the group with the clearest PFS benefit from polatuzumab in POLARIX

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.quote: escalated to 36 Gy if the end-of-treatment PET shows residual FDG uptake there. The mediastinal (2.6 cm) and cervical (3.1 cm) nodal sites are not bulky, so they get RT only if the end-of-treatment PET shows Deauville 4-5

mn_non_curative.quote: this is curable-intent disease with an approximately 50-60% chance of cure with current standard therapy

mn_da_epoch.quote: DA-EPOCH-R (no EFS or OS advantage over R-CHOP in the ProSPECT trial; it belongs to double-hit/very-high-risk biology, which he does not have

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2 IV day 1, doxorubicin 50 mg/m2 IV day 1

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: document that no antiviral prophylaxis is required (HBsAg negative, anti-HBc and anti-HBs reactive equals resolved infection with immunity), with monitoring and tenofovir/entecavir only if serologies change

hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.quote: No hepatitis B DNA or antiviral prophylaxis decision is documented; HBsAg negative with reactive anti-HBc and anti-HBs is resolved infection with immunity, so no antiviral is required, but I want this interpretation explicitly recorded and reactivation monitoring noted if his anti-HBs titre is low.

mn_no_hbv_action.quote: document that no antiviral prophylaxis is required (HBsAg negative, anti-HBc and anti-HBs reactive equals resolved infection with immunity)

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: High risk by the CNS-IPI, score 4 of 8 ... Decision: I will offer intrathecal CNS prophylaxis - methotrexate and/or cytarabine with each cycle of pola-R-CHP

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: I will offer intrathecal CNS prophylaxis - methotrexate and/or cytarabine with each cycle of pola-R-CHP

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: Lugano criteria with Deauville scoring, using FDG PET-CT as the primary response modality. End-of-treatment PET-CT at 8-12 weeks after the last cycle

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Deauville 4-5 requires biopsy of the abnormal site before any salvage decision, because post-chemotherapy inflammatory or infectious uptake

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Tumour lysis prophylaxis: allopurinol 300 mg daily (adjust to keep uric acid normal) with oral and IV hydration, and check potassium, phosphate, calcium, uric acid, LDH and creatinine before each cycle - he has a large-volume tumour with LDH 3x ULN

sup_gcsf.quote: Neutropenia: pegfilgrastim 6 mg SC 24-72 hours after each cycle (age over 60, double-expressor and bulky disease all add risk)

work_echo_reviewed.quote: Cumulative doxorubicin exposure will be 300 mg/m2 (approximately 594 mg total), which is within an acceptable anthracycline budget for a 62-year-old with LVEF 58%.

fit_full_dose.quote: He is therefore a fit candidate for aggressive curative therapy, but not a trivially fit one

miss_hbv_dna.quote: No hepatitis B DNA or antiviral prophylaxis decision is documented; HBsAg negative with reactive anti-HBc and anti-HBs is resolved infection with immunity, so no antiviral is required
